articles.title: Institutional crypto trading platform LMAX is exploring sale, IPO
articles.snippet: LMAX is working with Morgan Stanley and investment bank KBW to assess its options, which could lead to a sale or a public offering.

articles.title: Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev's X Account Hacked to Shill Fake 'Vladhood' Token
articles.snippet: The deleted post touted a bogus "Vladhood" token as the mascot of Robinhood Chain—the latest fraud to exploit a network currently dominated by memes.

articles.title: Arbitrum Perp DEX AFX Trade Drained of $24M, Offers Hacker 30% to Return It
articles.snippet: The exploit hit a custody bridge AFX operates rather than the Arbitrum network itself, with the stolen funds quickly moved to Ethereum.
